_meta.description: Generic amount / magnitude phrase library. Slot-level only — no card IDs. Fills {amount}, {p}, {t}, {n} at compose time; effect verbs stay in effects.json.
_meta.composition_rule: Pick an amount phrase to fill numeric slots on an effect. Prefer N_1..N_5 when the parsed value is known; use FIXED with {n} for other integers.
_meta.card_mapping: Per-card numeric bindings live in parsed_cards.jsonl (parser output), not in this library.
_meta.pool_note: Pool numeric mass is concentrated on 1–5; N_1..N_5 are first-class slots for graded relevance.
_meta.candidate_render_note: candidate_render is for synthetic card text, not query shorthand. Numeric candidates use complete amount expressions that remain grammatical before damage, life, cards, tokens, mana, and counters; semantic candidates are restricted to their own amount meaning and keep distribution or reference wording explicit.

N_1.note: All variants resolve to the fixed value 1; the renderer singularizes count nouns where needed.

N_2.note: All variants resolve to the fixed value 2 without changing the amount semantics.

N_3.note: All variants resolve to the fixed value 3 without changing the amount semantics.

N_4.note: All variants resolve to the fixed value 4 without changing the amount semantics.

N_5.note: All variants resolve to the fixed value 5 without changing the amount semantics.

FIXED.note: Requires a resolved integer amount_value; the renderer fills both numeric and spelled-number forms.
